recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not re-add DeviceUsage or Citation to core DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo.reference unless the work group explicitly restores those resources to active core build scope or adopts a current core-to-additional-resources reference policy.
issue_request: FHIR-45132 was an Applied O&O change request, resolved Persuasive for R6, asking to add ImagingStudy, FamilyMemberHistory, Condition, AllergyIntolerance, and DeviceUsage as DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo.reference target types.
initial_application: The request was applied before this reconciliation. Commit e7d3d5938924eb0ecf793c36cfcb01ec8c5f641d added FamilyMemberHistory, AllergyIntolerance, and DeviceUsage but duplicated Citation and missed Condition; commit 362275da8e189dc154ce592e46577955bc110e03 removed the duplicate Citation; and commit c06eed2fe60267b528fe5b991dbf2820bb105965 added Condition, matching the Jira comment that Condition was the remaining gap.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps DiagnosticReport and the currently retained supportingInfo targets active, but DeviceUsage and Citation are no longer active core resources. Later commits 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32, 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36, and fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e removed DeviceUsage, Citation, and other additional/out-of-core targets from active core scope and/or DiagnosticReport target lists. FHIR-48391 later added DocumentReference and the current supportingInfo type binding, which is compatible with the seed decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source includes ImagingStudy, FamilyMemberHistory, Condition, and AllergyIntolerance for DiagnosticReport.supportingInfo.reference, and omits DeviceUsage and Citation because they are out of the current core build scope.
